form.notes: Form-associated (ElementInternals): submits `name=id` of the chosen item, resets to `defaultItem` (or the `value` attribute), restores on navigation (the state carries the label too), joins <fieldset disabled>, works with form= and label for. `required` means an item is chosen, whatever is typed. Enter in the open results chooses and never submits; with the results closed it submits like a text input.

differences.text: Uncontrolled by default: `item` is a property (with `defaultItem` and the `value` attribute as defaults) and the user's choice fires the cancelable `tct-selection-change` followed by the native `input` and `change`, instead of a controlled `value` plus `onChange`. Set the property to control it.

`hasClear` (default true) becomes the inverted `no-clear` attribute. `startIcon` is an icon name plus a `start` slot; `onChangeQuery` is the native `input` event with a `query` getter; `onOpenChange` is the cancelable `tct-open-change` plus `tct-after-open-change`.

`tct-selection-change` is a new event shared by the typeahead family: `action` (`select`, `add`, `create`, `remove`, `clear`), `item`, `items` and `reason`. It lives in core (`events/tct-selection-change.ts`) so `tct-tokenizer` and other selectors can reuse it.
Form-associated with a `name`, `required` validity and restore state (the upstream field has no form participation of its own): the submitted value is the item id.

Result counts (or the empty message) are announced once per menu through the announcer, not on every keystroke; an older response never replaces a newer one (a generation counter plus `cancel()`); an IME composition Enter never chooses.
Escape in edit mode restores the token and returns focus to it, so a keyboard user does not lose their place; the hidden input is out of the tab order while the token shows.

Result rows use the Tecton table-row hover fill for the highlight and the pressed overlay for `:active`; every state's text was checked for contrast in light and dark (tct-typeahead.states.test.ts). The chosen item shows as a `tct-token`.

requests.reason: Unify the combobox logic with the WP-11 `controllers/combobox.ts` once both are merged: the `TypeaheadEngine` (active descendant, debounce with a generation counter, once-per-menu announcements, IME guard, popup show/hide) is the editable-combobox half; the selectors' listbox half should share the same core controller instead of two implementations.
`tct-selection-change` is new in this work package; if WP-11 (selectors) defines an event with the same name, keep one class and reconcile its `action` union.
`tct-token` (linked) needs the same URL-policy, target/rel and router hand-off as `tct-link`; a shared click-router helper (link + token + card) would replace the copy in `tct-token.ts`.

core.typeahead.notes: Guides: [mwg:form-associated-custom-elements] value, validity, reset and restore; [mwg:accessibility] editable combobox with active descendant; [mwg:ime-safe-enter-submit] Enter never selects while composing; [mwg:resilient-context-menus-and-nested-dropdowns] the result popup is a manual popover anchored to the field, dismissed by focus leaving. Known defect outside this folder: the shared success status ink measures 3.97:1 on the field background (field-status tokens), so the contrast tests exclude the success status. Size: about 79 kB gzipped for tct-typeahead.js, 7 kB above tct-text-area (72 kB): the shared box control and field chrome, the popup, the position and layer controllers with the Floating UI fallback, tct-token and the engine.

differences.text: `icon` is a slot; `label` and `group` are also attributes so a row can be written in markup. The element is presentational: the popup owns the `option` role, selection and the highlight, so it never takes focus.

core.typeahead-item.notes: Presentational; exercised inside every popup of the family (tct-base-typeahead.test.ts, tct-typeahead.test.ts, the contrast-state tests).

form.notes: A bare input: not form-associated. The input is a real `<input>` in the shadow root that does not submit. Use `tct-typeahead` for a form field.

differences.text: Uncontrolled: `item` marks the selected result and a choice fires the cancelable `tct-selection-change` then the native `input` and `change`. `anchorRef` becomes `anchorElement` / the `anchor` id attribute.

The combobox logic is the `TypeaheadEngine` controller, shared by `tct-base-typeahead`, `tct-typeahead` and `tct-tokenizer`, instead of the two fields composing the base element. `aria-activedescendant` and `aria-controls` are ID references that cannot cross the shadow boundary between a field and a nested base element, so each field owns its input and popup in one shadow root.

The popup is a manual popover in the top layer (never clipped by an ancestor), positioned with the anchor and a Floating UI fallback; pressing an option keeps focus in the input; a stale response never replaces a newer one.

core.base-typeahead.notes: Guides: [mwg:accessibility] combobox pattern; [mwg:ime-safe-enter-submit]; [mwg:resilient-context-menus-and-nested-dropdowns] popup dismissal. The keyboard behaviour is verified in tct-base-typeahead.test.ts; the table-driven suite runs on tct-typeahead, which has the same table plus the token editing rows.
